result.instructions: Tools for Reftab, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which laptops are checked out, and to whom?"; "Which software licenses renew in the next 60 days, and what do they cost?"; "Show every overdue loan and how many days late each one is.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Reftab data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run reftab_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reftab_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reftab_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. reftab_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reftab_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List assets with optional filters, e.g. location, category, status or who has them on loan. Returns the first 50 by default. Reftab API: GET /api/assets.

clid.description: Location ID, or comma-separated location IDs.

cid.description: Category ID, or comma-separated category IDs.

query.description: Free-text search in the asset fields.

status.description: Asset status filter (as Reftab names it).

loanDetails.description: Set to include loan details in each asset (Reftab flag).

loaneeDetails.description: Set to include loanee details in each asset (Reftab flag).

tools.name: reftab_get_asset
tools.title: Get an asset
tools.description: Get one asset by its asset ID (the barcode/tag, e.g. MAC000001). Reftab API: GET /api/assets/{aid}.

aid.description: The asset ID, as used in Reftab (barcode).

tools.name: reftab_get_asset_loan_history
tools.title: Get an asset's loan history
tools.description: List the loans and checkout/return history of one asset that the key may read. Useful for audits and chain of custody. Reftab API: GET /api/assets/{aid}/loans/history.

tools.name: reftab_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List all locations (sites, rooms, offices) with their IDs, names and asset counts. Reftab API: GET /api/locations.

tools.name: reftab_get_location
tools.title: Get a location
tools.description: Get one location by its location ID (clid), including its asset and license counts. Reftab API: GET /api/locations/{clid}.

tools.name: reftab_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List asset categories with their IDs and names. Reftab API: GET /api/categories.

tools.name: reftab_list_licenses
tools.title: List licenses
tools.description: List software licenses, with optional search, sort and status filters, e.g. to find renewals and costs. Reftab API: GET /api/licenses.

sort.description: Field to sort by (as Reftab names it).

status.description: License status filter (as Reftab names it).

tools.name: reftab_get_license
tools.title: Get a license
tools.description: Get one license by its numeric ID, including cost, vendor, seats and notification settings. Reftab API: GET /api/licenses/{id}.

tools.name: reftab_list_loans
tools.title: List loans
tools.description: List current and past loans (checkouts) of assets, licenses, accessories and kits, with optional filters such as status, loanee or activity dates. Reftab API: GET /api/loans.

status.description: Loan status filter (as Reftab names it).

type.description: Loan type filter (as Reftab names it).

loanee.description: Loanee name or ID filter (as Reftab names it).

activitySince.description: Only loans with activity on or after this date.

activityUntil.description: Only loans with activity on or before this date.

tools.name: reftab_list_loanees
tools.title: List loanees
tools.description: Search people who can hold loans (loanees and sub-users) by name or email. Reftab API: GET /api/loanees.

tools.name: reftab_get_loanee
tools.title: Get a loanee
tools.description: Get one loanee (person) by ID, with the details Reftab holds for them. Reftab API: GET /api/loanees/{lnid}.

tools.name: reftab_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations of assets, licenses, accessories and kits, with optional filters. Reftab API: GET /api/reservations.

status.description: Reservation status filter (as Reftab names it).

tools.name: reftab_list_accessories
tools.title: List accessories
tools.description: List accessories (small items such as chargers or cables) with their stock and category. Reftab API: GET /api/accessories.

expanded.description: Set to include the expanded accessory details (Reftab flag).

tools.name: reftab_list_kits
tools.title: List kits
tools.description: List kits (bundles of assets and accessories) that the key may read. Reftab API: GET /api/kits.

tools.name: reftab_list_asset_maintenance
tools.title: List maintenance records
tools.description: List asset maintenance records with optional filters, e.g. overdue or open work on one asset or location. Reftab API: GET /api/assetmaintenance.

status.description: Maintenance status filter (as Reftab names it).

tools.name: reftab_get_asset_maintenance
tools.title: Get a maintenance record
tools.description: Get one asset maintenance record by its ID. Reftab API: GET /api/assetmaintenance/{amid}.

tools.name: reftab_list_statuses
tools.title: List statuses and custom fields
tools.description: List the asset statuses, categories and custom-field definitions of the account. Use it to pick valid filter values. Reftab API: GET /api/status.
